other_conditions: Resident of Tamil Nadu for at least 3 years
Minimum qualification of 12th standard, diploma, ITI or recognized vocational training
Project cost must be between ₹10 lakh and ₹5 crore
Project must be a new project sanctioned under the NEEDS scheme
Applicants who have previously received assistance under PMRY, REGP, PMEGP, UYEGP, TAHDCO or any other Government scheme are ineligible
Applicants who have availed loans for economic activity under Self Help Group or other group activity are ineligible
Applicant must not be a defaulter to any Commercial Bank or TIIC
Cannot avail capital subsidy under any other State Government scheme
Promoter’s contribution must be at least 10% of project cost for General category and 5% for Special category
Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training is mandatory
Partnership concerns may be considered, but only one partner will receive EDP training
Land value can be counted as promoter’s contribution subject to title conditions
benefits_summary: Provides up to 25% subsidy (capped at ₹75 lakhs) and a 3% interest subvention, with priority allotment in SIDCO industrial estates.
